name: Invopop

sandbox.notes: "You can start building and testing in the sandbox immediately, no sales call required" (Invopop's own wording, verified directly on the vendor's own site, 2026-09-23). A 'Developer' paid tier (~50 EUR/mo, per a comparator, UNVERIFIED) reportedly exists for production.

provenance.sourceText: backend/src/modules/documents/transports/invopop-transport.ts header: "Invopop (invopop.com), a transmission platform registered by the DGFiP and self-serve in sandbox."

notes: The one operator whose API does NOT speak an EN 16931-derived structured format directly: it takes GOBL, Invopop's own JSON pivot model, and converts to the local syntax INSIDE a published workflow it runs server-side (invopop/gobl-invoice.ts). A completed job that still carries 'faults' is treated as a failure even though its own 'status' field reads 'OK' -- Invopop's own documentation states this is how a failed step's error branch reports itself; reading success off 'status' alone would be a false green (invopop-transport.ts's own header).
